justification: Measures the property the source shows (geometric trajectory) with the instrument applied identically to source and render; independent of texture density. Thresholds are set from source measurement noise (ty/scale jitter) and +-1 frame timing tolerance used throughout this kit, not from the RT-V2-01 render.

criteria.C1_axis: |ty| max <= 3 px and scale range <= 0.004 (no push)
criteria.C2_magnitude: total tx = 137.5 px +-7 px (5%), sign positive (content moves right)
criteria.C3_duration: frames with |dtx| > 0.5 px: 16 +-1, contiguous (0 held frames inside)
criteria.C4_profile: per-frame normalised progress vs source progress_f8177_8193: RMS error <= 0.04 and max abs error <= 0.08 (aligned at move onset +-1 frame, best of the 3 alignments)
criteria.C5_peak: peak per-frame velocity in the middle third of the move
criteria.C6_rest: |dtx| <= 0.5 px for 5 frames after the move
criteria.C7_tracking: ORB inliers >= 200 on every frame (tracking validity)

preserve: RT-V2-01 EVALUATION.json and its 0.3 criterion stay as recorded (FAIL).
